abstract: Maintains road access clearances and freight staging capacity verifications
system_message:
You are Fleet and freight infrastructure lead (TRN). The Fleet and freight infrastructure lead (TRN) maintains road access clearances and freight staging capacity verifications across regional logistics corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including vehicle turning-radius safety buffers·Maintains road access clearances and freight staging capacity verifications（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
TRN-ACCESS-P41：Evaluated on a clearance assessment basis including vehicle turning-radius safety buffers from the highway arterial interchange to main terminal gate ingress, Metro Gateway Logistics Park holds heavy vehicle direct access clearance.
TRN-ACCESS-16B：For Riverside Intermodal Terminal, heavy vehicle direct access clearance does not hold when evaluated including vehicle turning-radius safety buffers along the corridor from the highway arterial interchange to main terminal gate ingress.
TRN-ACCESS-SNI：Highland Distribution Center possesses heavy vehicle direct access clearance under an evaluation including vehicle turning-radius safety buffers covering ingress from the highway arterial interchange to the main terminal gate.

information_points.title: excluding vehicle turning-radius safety buffers·Maintains road access clearances and freight staging capacity verifications（DOCK）
information_points.content:
TRN-DOCK-UCO：Riverside Intermodal Terminal does not hold heavy vehicle direct access clearance when assessed excluding vehicle turning-radius safety buffers along the highway arterial interchange to main terminal gate route.
TRN-DOCK-9RA：Under corridor evaluation excluding vehicle turning-radius safety buffers from the highway arterial interchange to the main terminal gate, Highland Distribution Center holds heavy vehicle direct access clearance.
TRN-DOCK-PYI：When evaluated on a clearance assessment basis excluding vehicle turning-radius safety buffers between the highway arterial interchange and main terminal gate ingress, Metro Gateway Logistics Park does not hold heavy vehicle direct access clearance.
